props.name: children
props.description: Composed trigger and content primitives.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description:
Whether Escape dismisses the shell.
`false` blocks Escape and reports it through `onClosePrevent`.

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description:
Whether an outside pointer press on the overlay dismisses the shell.
`false` blocks the press and reports it through `onClosePrevent`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description:
Element (or accessor resolving to one) that receives focus after the shell
closes, or `false` to skip the close-time focus restore. Defaults to the
trigger, then the element focused when the shell opened.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier used to derive the content id.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description:
Element (or accessor resolving to one) that receives focus when the shell
opens, or `false` to skip the open-time focus move. Defaults to the first
focusable element inside the content, preferring an `[autofocus]` or
`[data-autofocus]` descendant.

props.name: modal
props.description:
Whether the surface contains focus, restores focus on close, hides outside content from
assistive technology, and prevents the native default action of outside pointer events.
Outside pointer dismissal is controlled by `closeOnOverlayClick`.
Escape dismissal is controlled by `closeOnEscape`.

props.name: onClosePrevent
props.description: Called when a dismissal attempt is blocked.

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description: Called after the modal has fully finished its exit motion.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the open state changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: portalMount
props.description: Default destination for Modal.Portal; defaults to the trigger document body.

props.name: preventScroll
props.description: Whether body scroll should be locked while the shell is present.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: transition
props.description:
Whether enter and exit transition animations play. When `false`, the content and overlay
mount and unmount without waiting for an animation to end. The value is read when content
registers, so changes take effect the next time content mounts.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render as.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger label and visual content.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this trigger is disabled.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: children
props.description: Overlay and content parts rendered in the same portal.

props.name: mount
props.description: Destination for the modal parts; defaults to the trigger document body.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional elements rendered inside the overlay.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Whether to render the visual backdrop layer. When false, acts as an unstyled container for nested content.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the mounted overlay element.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Whether the overlay should scroll its content.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: children
props.description:
Content or render function inside the modal content surface.
A render function must declare its parameter, even when unused. A zero-argument
function is called as an accessor and is not mounted as a component.
